name: Heilon Prime (Hellonex Principal World)
polity: Principal Capital of Hellonex · Industrial Powerhouse
stage1: Condensed within a super-dense, heavy-metal proto-stellar disk enriched by an ancient neutron-star merger.
stage2: Locked into a 260-local-day orbital/rotational resonance cycle—directly inspiring the 260-day Mayan Tzolk'in-modeled Hellonian Calendar alongside GFST.
stage3: Accreted a massive iron-iridium core and hyper-active tectonic mantle; high volcanic outgassing forged vast surface plateaus of exposed metallic veins.
stage4: Abundant refractory alloys, geothermal vents, and high-density ores made planetary-scale smelting and orbital shipyards naturally viable.
stage5: Emerged as the industrial powerhouse of the Galactic Federation (anchoring Draxon Prime and Eryndros), balancing Astrysis's science and Aetherion's raw extraction.

name: Eryndros (Hellonex-Affiliated World)
stage1: Formed in the outer frost-line transition zone of its star system with volatile ices layered over a geothermal silicate core.
stage2: Synchronized to GFST for colonial administration while tracking industrial quotas on the 260-day Hellonian cycle.
stage3: Developed a hollow, crystalline-ice and subterranean geothermal crust—creating pockets of subterranean heat ("Thermasis") beneath fragile crystalline caverns.
stage4: Sub-surface thermal energy attracted heavy colonial extraction (Thermasis Colony, GFST 95), but over-stressing the crystalline strata risked systemic crustal failure.
stage5: Suffered the catastrophic Crystalis Collapse at GFST 140 when the thermal-crystalline equilibrium shattered, directly necessitating the planetary-scale Frostveil Initiative at GFST 200.

name: Astrysis Prime / Lyvithar Prime
polity: Capital World of Astrysis · Cultural & Scientific Center
stage1: Ignited around a stable, long-lived main-sequence star with low flare activity and a clean magnetosphere.
stage2: Gentle axial tilt and predictable seasonal harmonics fostered early astronomical observation and standardized timekeeping.
stage3: Formed stable continental cratons separated by calm archipelagic seas; low seismic devastation allowed ancient libraries and observatories to survive millennia.
stage4: Long-term ecological stability favored cognitive, philosophical, and scientific continuity over sheer survivalist industrialism.
stage5: Became the intellectual and cultural heart of the Galactic Federation, integrating Phorvallis and Luminethra, associating with Veridun, and evaluating frontier worlds Myrcathis and Velstron.

name: Aetherion Cluster (Black Hole Habitats)
polity: Third Principal Stellar-State · The Resource Nexus
stage1: Stellar core collapse birthed a gravitational singularity surrounded by shattered planetary remnants and rogue planetoids.
stage2: Relativistic time-dilation gradients near the black hole required an absolute external benchmark—making the Aetherion Beacon (GFST 75) and GFST essential.
stage3: No single planet formed; instead, mineral-rich rogue planetoids and shattered planetary cores were trapped in chaotic orbits until stabilized by the Aetherion Beacon at GFST 75.
stage4: Exposed planetary cores (stripped of crusts by tidal forces) offered direct, zero-overburden access to rare heavy isotopes and singularity energy.
stage5: Granted the Galactic Federation strategic resource independence, earning recognition as the third Principal Stellar-State alongside Astrysis and Hellonex.

name: Omnexis (Disputed / Independent System)
polity: Independent System (Privateers & Research Enclaves) / Hellonex Draft Overlap
stage1: Formed inside a dense debris-disk and sensor-scattering ionized nebula on the flank of Hellonex space.
stage2: Irregular outer-system orbital paths create natural navigational blind spots between standard GFST beacon lanes.
stage3: Fragmented moons and shadowed planetary canyons provide concealed natural harbors and isolated laboratory basins.
stage4: Proximity to Hellonex industrial shipping lanes combined with nebula cover rewarded both autonomous scientific experimentation and privateering.
stage5: Appeared in early Hellonex territorial claims while operating de facto as an independent system of privateers and research enclaves.

name: Zykaris (Fallen Civilization)
stage1: Ancient stellar nursery seeded during an early radiative surge.
stage2: Pre-Federation local epochs now indexed post-mortem by Astrysis archaeologists and Caretakers.
stage3: Planetary surface scarred by terminal civilization-scale catastrophe (open canon slot for exact geological trigger).
stage4: Dormant ruins, relic infrastructure, and cautionary archaeological strata.
stage5: Stands as a fallen civilization outside the Galactic Federation—a major mystery for Astrysis scholars and Celestial Library Caretakers alike.
